data.content_ref: inline:The 'systemic blind spots' identified in SRC_004 are compatible with the 'blind spots shared by all non-experts' mentioned as a countercondition in SRC_001. Together, they suggest that the panel's reliability is capped not by individual variance, but by the intersection of the non-experts' shared conceptual limitations. This relation is refuted if it is shown that non-experts' blind spots are uncorrelated and thus can be filtered out by a sufficiently large panel.
